# Data dictionary overview

| Table | Grain |
|---|---|
| `accounting_firm` | one accounting practice |
| `office` | one office |
| `employee` | one permanent employee |
| `client_company` | one served legal entity |
| `client_assignment` | one current manager/accountant assignment |
| `client_event` | one lifecycle event |
| `service_contract` | one principal contract |
| `contract_service` | one service in a contract |
| `accounting_document` | one primary document |
| `business_invoice` | one AR or AP invoice |
| `payment` | one payment allocation |
| `bank_transaction` | one bank movement |
| `reconciliation_match` | one invoice/transaction match |
| `journal_entry` | one entry header |
| `journal_line` | one debit or credit line |
| `tax_filing` | one filing instance |
| `work_item` | one accounting task |
| `communication_event` | one interaction |
| `firm_invoice` | one accounting-firm invoice |
| `firm_payment` | one payment of a firm invoice |
